name: Homing Arcane Missile
description: A violet crystal missile charges, kicks off on a gentle arc, then hooks hard after a target that moves mid-flight, trailing a braid of soft ribbons and orbiting shards into a crystal burst.

metadata.analysis: spawn_charge 0-0.2 violet orb, contracting halo ring, motes rushing in | launch 0.2-0.4 the crystal forms inside the flash and kicks forward, ribbons start | mid_flight 0.4-1.0 gentle arc away from the target, braid of three ribbons and two filaments, three orbiting shards with thin trails, sparkle motes | target_adjust 1.0-1.4 the target has moved: a tightening, accelerating hook down and towards the camera | impact 1.4-1.6 core flash, irregular soft rays, tumbling crystal shards, sparks, a faint expanding ring | dissipate 1.6-1.8 a loose ring of fading motes

layout.target_side: 1 = the authored target; 0 = the target never moved; 2 = it moved twice as far
